risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (299.68) indicates extreme market stress, and macro_score of -4 reflects deteriorating conditions; earnings in 98 days poses minimal near-term event risk but overall environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 299.68, macro_score -4), zero fundamental momentum (no insider/institutional conviction, high earnings risk in 98 days), weak trend strength (ADX 14.95), and no triggered strategy override technical signals.
